name: Vaxfab Enterprises Ltd
tagline: Micro-cap agri-commodity trading company after a huge price run — auditor disclaimer of opinion, zero promoter holding, 400+ debtor days
business_overview: Vaxfab Enterprises Ltd (formerly Ellora Trading Ltd) trades agricultural commodities and has announced an intent to diversify into trading textiles and clothing. BSE-listed micro-cap (~Rs 166 Cr).
fundamentals_table: FY26 revenue ~Rs 100 Cr; net profit ~Rs 3.6 Cr (swung positive)
Debtor days ~414 — up from ~302 at the prior screen
Public shareholders ~100% — no promoter or institutional holding
Auditor issued a disclaimer on standalone results (prior-record / MSMED Act compliance issues)
fundamentals_narrative: The company has swung to a small net profit (~Rs 3.6 Cr) since the old 108-stock screen flagged it AVOID for being loss-making with ~302 debtor days after a +241% one-year run. But the situation is not cleaner: debtor days are now ~414, there is effectively no promoter holding (public ~100%), and the auditor issued a disclaimer on the standalone financials citing prior-record and MSMED-Act compliance issues. A disclaimer of opinion means the reported numbers cannot be relied on.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; prior +241% one-year move well ahead of fundamentals.

verdict_headline: AVOID — auditor disclaimer, no promoter holding and 400+ debtor days make the numbers untrustworthy
verdict_reasoning: Re-check of a legacy-108-screen seed; the old 2026-08-15 AVOID (loss-making, high debtor days) is retained. A small reported profit does not offset an auditor disclaimer of opinion
Zero promoter holding plus ~414 debtor days plus the disclaimer is a combination that fails the quality gate outright
